caption: The drawing displays three objects on a plain, beige background. The largest object, positioned in the upper right, is a wooden cylindrical mold with a rounded handle, rendered in shades of light brown and tan with visible wood grain texture. Below it, slightly to the left, is a circular object that shows the bottom of the mold; it features a carved floral or botanical design consisting of a central line, leaf-like shapes on the left, and three round berries or buds on the right, all enclosed by concentric circles. The smallest object is located in the lower right corner, depicted in a schematic, cross-sectional view, showing the internal structure of the mold with a handle and the carved section at the base, and is drawn in a darker brown outline with lighter brown shading. The composition is organized with ample negative space around the objects, and the name "Wellington Blewett" is inscribed in small text at the bottom left.
title: Butter Mold
